reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 1820 for the 6188-receiver graph. Lower bound is an independent set of size 1820 (check passed); upper bound is a linear code M = I + A over F_7 of length 1820 (code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passed), found with 1 code tried. Versus baselines: CP-SAT alpha reached only 1491 unproven in 136.3 s, cpsat_cover timed out, frac_cover stayed at the trivial 6188, f2_minrank_sat gave lower 1490 only. kushagra_agent also proved 1820 (field 7) in 22.98 s, faster than our 36.678 s wall time; our compute was just 4.761 s, with 31.917 s spent in LLM calls (2 calls, 1 critic round). Nothing suspicious, though decoding was verified by trials rather than exhaustively.
